title: ClawVision Skill
subtitle: From Codex $visualize to a local summary generator for OpenClaw
main_takeaway: User saw the $visualize skill in Codex and asked for an OpenClaw equivalent we could publish on clawhub. I built a live skill that turns session history into a tabbed HTML card.
format_takeaway: The discussion moved from idea to MVP: define the format, create a pending skill, write the renderer, test on two real sessions, translate to English.
next_takeaway: Next step is to create a GitHub repo and submit the skill to clawhub.

metrics.title: 🎯 Goal
metrics.text: Turn OpenClaw session history into a clean, tabbed HTML card.

metrics.title: 🔧 Approach
metrics.text: Use sessions_history + node_inference + local Playwright renderer.

metrics.title: 📤 Output
metrics.text: Self-contained HTML, Markdown, PowerPoint, and PNG screenshots.

dos: Keep tabs clear: takeaway, format, built, next.
Use cards and flow diagrams instead of walls of text.
donts: Force English when the chat was in another language.

checklist.text: HTML template with tabs and inline CSS
Tested on a second real session

Submit the repo link to clawhub.
